answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 21409 Country: India Title: I have been married for more than two year. I have no child and as per Doctor the reason of infertility is unexplained. Please let me know the reason and guide me how can I overcome from it. Question: Assalam Alaikum Hazrat Sahib, I have been married for more than two year. I have no child and as per Doctor the reason of infertility is unexplained. Please let me know the reason and guide me how can I overcome from it. Please Answer ID: 21409 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 564/427/D=1431) (1) Recite the following dua after every salah 11 times with durood before and after, and supplicate Allah insha-Allah the blessing of Allah will turn towards you: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْداً وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ [الأنبياء : 89] (2) Boil two eggs and peel it, read the following verse on one egg and give it to your husband to eat: وَالسَّمَاء بَنَيْنَاهَا بِأَيْدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ [الذاريات : 47] While read the following verse on the other egg and eat it: وَالْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَاهَا فَنِعْمَ الْمَاهِدُونَ [الذاريات : 48] Follow this practice for forty days, in-sha-Allah you will get your need fulfilled. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
